about: Every read of MeteoAlarm's portugal feed by tools/source-meteoalarm.mjs: when, the sha256 of the bytes received, their size, how many CAP messages, and what changed since the read before (counts; the detail is the diff file named). The bytes themselves are in the data vault (../../dataset.json), never in git. Facts about the feed as we received it.

reads.note: first read: the baseline, nothing to compare with

vault.dated: none: the same bytes as the previous read
